verdict.rationale: HubSpot's marketing page claims multi-touch revenue attribution and customer-journey analytics, so revenue attribution is a documented first-party capability. However, the evidence never shows attribution at the level of individual emails or workflows/flows; the email API only mentions generic post-send statistics. Missing for 10: documented attribution of signups/revenue to specific emails and workflows, attribution model and reporting details beyond a marketing-page claim, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks

citations.quote: Drive revenue with multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics that show what's actually working.
See exactly where in the customer journey visitors are ready to convert and place the right touchpoints at the right moments.
You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
